name: boundary
title: Match boundaries between pieces of text

origin.description: boundary() matches boundaries between characters, line breaks, sentences, or words. The pattern text itself is missing.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Boundary to detect: character, line_break, sentence, or word. The choice must be exact. The default vector selects character.

arguments.name: skip_word_none
arguments.text: If TRUE, ignore word boundaries that contain no letters or numbers. NA, the default, is TRUE only for type word and FALSE otherwise.
Further arguments passed to stringi::stri_opts_brkiter(), such as locale.

origin.details: character breaks at every character. line_break breaks where the locale allows a line break. sentence uses the Unicode sentence rules. word breaks at the edges of words. A unique prefix such as "w" is not word. The stored pattern is a length-1 NA.
origin.value: A length-1 missing character, with classes stringr_boundary, stringr_pattern, and character, and a break-iterator option list.

translation.description: boundary() selects a break iterator. The pattern value is a length-1 NA.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: One of character, line_break, sentence, or word. The string must match exactly. The default is character.

arguments.name: skip_word_none
arguments.text: If True, skip word pieces that contain no letters or numbers. The default NA is True only when type is word.

arguments.name: kwargs
arguments.text: Further arguments passed to stri_opts_brkiter, such as locale.

translation.details: The Pattern holds stringi's NA and kind bound. boundary() stores type character and skip_word_none false. boundary("word") stores skip_word_none true. "w" raises an error instead of selecting word.
translation.value: A Pattern of kind bound. The only element is NA. options contains type and skip_word_none.
